subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Timberlane Technologies
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: James Hart <james.hart@timberlane.io>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@timberlane.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Timberlane Technologies

Hi James and Elena,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciated the clear context on the three workloads you want to evaluate (search ranking, chat-based support triage, and nightly batch embedding refresh). Per our conversation, I put together a concise POC proposal and timeline so we can align on success criteria, ownership, and next steps. Attached is a one-page plan and our network checklist to speed onboarding.

Quick recap of what we showed
- Redwood inference runtime: predictable low-latency serving, continuous batching, and KV cache for chat flows
- Deploy modes: hosted API for fast iteration, dedicated pool for sustained throughput
- Observability: per-route latency and cost dashboards plus token-level traces

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks, adjustable)
- Goal: Validate production viability for two production flows (real-time chat triage + ranking) and one nightly embedding refresh.
- Environments: Hosted sandbox + Dedicated trial for peak load tests (customer-managed data remains in your VPC during dedicated testing)

Success criteria (please confirm / adjust)
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 120 ms for chat triage at expected concurrency (20 RPS)
2) Cost: baseline per-token cost target <= $0.004 for ranking workloads using suggested batching/quantization profile
3) Quality: no automated-regression vs control prompts (we will run your 120 prompt eval set)
4) Reliability: <1% error rate during 24-hour soak at expected concurrency

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm success criteria, sign evaluation SOW, pre-kickoff network & IAM checklist completed
- Week 1: Sandbox environment + sample data ingestion, security review (SOC2 evidence shared)
- Week 2: Full integration with test traffic, run baseline evals, adjust batching/quantization
- Week 3: Dedicated throughput run and soak (24–48 hours), collect latency/cost metrics
- Week 4: Final evaluation, results review, decision (go/no-go + next steps)

Owners
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (AE) — commercial; Monica Patel (SE) — technical lead and onboarding
- Timberlane: James Hart — engineering lead; Elena Ruiz — security/compliance

Next steps (action items)
1) Please review the success criteria above and reply with any changes by EOD Monday 5/18
2) If good, indicate who will sign the evaluation SOW; we will send a DocuSign link for a 30-day free evaluation
3) Share a point of contact and single IP range for the network checklist to get pre-approved
4) Proposed kickoff: Wed, May 20 at 10:00 AM PT (we can adjust)

Attachments referenced: [attachment: 20260514-timberlane-poc-plan.pdf] [attachment: timberlane-network-checklist.xlsx]

Thanks — looking forward to getting the POC running quickly.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for teams
From: James Hart <james.hart@timberlane.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@timberlane.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Timberlane Technologies

Karthik — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. A couple of quick notes from our side after syncing with engineering and security: 

1) Security evidence: We will need SOC 2 Type II or equivalent documentation before we kick off the dedicated runs. Can you share that in Week 1 along with any penetration test summaries?
2) Workloads: For the real-time tests, please include two variants of ranking traffic: (a) high-cardinality product catalog queries and (b) personalized session-scoped reranking. We want to ensure batching doesn't introduce tail latency for (b).
3) Timeline: We prefer to extend the soak/throughput window to Week 3–4 (i.e., move the decision call to end of Week 5) so our SRE team can run two separate soak windows. If this is fine, we can still start sandbox ingestion next week.

Assignees on our side: I'll be primary for engineering coordination; Elena will own security questions. I will confirm the signer for the SOW by Monday.

Quick replies inline quoting your original: 
> Success criteria 1: 95th pct < 120 ms — we want to test at both 20 RPS and 60 RPS peak bursts
> Success criteria 2: cost <= $0.004 — ok but include quantization trade-offs in the report

I can do the kickoff on Thu, May 21 instead of the 20th.

Thanks,
James
Senior Director, Engineering — Timberlane Technologies
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: James Hart <james.hart@timberlane.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@timberlane.io>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Timberlane Technologies

James — great, thanks for the feedback and the clear assignees. We can accommodate the adjustments you requested. Confirmations below: 

- SOC2 evidence and a short PT summary: Monica will share the SOC2 Type II pack and the redacted penetration test executive summary in Week 1 (we'll upload to a secure transfer link and share access).
- Workload variants: We'll add the two ranking traffic variants to the test plan (high-cardinality + session-scoped reranking). Monica will instrument tail-latency tracing to ensure batching doesn't impact the session-scoped flows.
- Timeline shift: Agreed — move detailed soak windows into Week 3 and Week 4 and plan a decision/lessons-learned review at end of Week 5. We'll still start sandbox ingestion next week.

Action items from Redwood (owned)
- Send updated POC plan with explicit test permutations and revised timeline (attaching v1.1) — Monica will own
- Share SOC2 and PT executive summary by Tue, 5/19
- Send DocuSign evaluation SOW for signature by Monday 5/18 (AE) — link below

DocuSign (evaluation SOW): https://www.docusign.com/sign/POC-EVAL-SOW-TRL-2026
Proposed kickoff: Thu, May 21, 10:00 AM PT — tentatively booked on our side, will update calendar after you confirm signer.

Monica — can you lead the technical kickoff and confirm availability for the 21st?

Thanks — we will be ready to move quickly once we have the signer and the network IP ranges.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
